title: Fixing PSII: Membrane fluidity facilitates FtsH functions
content: The thylakoid membrane of chloroplasts contains 2 photosystem complexes that initiate the conversion of light to usable energy during photosynthesis. However, the photosystems are vulnerable to oxidative damage in the highly reactive environment of thylakoid membranes. In particular, the core components of PSII, known as D1 and D2, frequently must be replaced to maintain activity.
